title: Which compute for this work?
claim: A function suits short-lived, event-driven tasks, and long or steady work points to a container or an instance.
alt: A decision ladder with three questions. Work that starts on an event and ends within minutes leads to a Lambda function; long or steady container work leads to AWS Fargate; work that needs control of the host leads to Amazon EC2.

rungs.q: Is each run a short-lived, event-driven task?
Is it long or steady container work?
Do you need control of the host?
